svg.text: WF-006: captured transfer (option B), N=2, 1:1 clocks, one destination wait cycle

PARA_AHS4_DST_MODE=1: o_req and o_data are registered one destination cycle after the synchronized request; the destination acknowledge is registered one destination cycle after reg_req && i_ack. o_ack is 8 source cycles after launch; the cycle closes in 15 source cycles.
